decision: Abandon the gated 7937c22 scale-ladder campaign; do not debug reconcile_scale_ladder_gate.py
rationale: Gate 250838 is verifiably PENDING/JobHeldUser per scontrol, yet reconcile_scale_ladder_gate.py:225 raises ValueError('gate is not proven held by the user'). The recovery path refuses the exact state it exists to recover. Activation job 250113 FAILED after 13s on the same line. Five prior campaigns produced zero scientific rows.
alternatives_rejected: (a) fix _require_gate_held and retry the gated campaign -- rejected: sixth attempt at the same layer, unbounded; (b) rebuild the launcher -- rejected: that is what consumed the week

decision: Ladder-lite: keep launch_scale_ladder.py --plan-out as the frozen cell definition, replace only the submission layer with plain sbatch arrays
rationale: build_plan() is the reviewed, valuable half (freezes 138 cell definitions, validates the instance manifest) and already runs without --submit. Both paths read the same approved-plan.json, so rows are scientifically identical; only provenance differs.
alternatives_rejected: (a) new hardened launcher -- rejected, same failure class; (b) run cells by hand -- rejected, no provenance and no reuse of the normalizer

decision: Keep 2 of the 13 submit-time guards: detached checkout at a named commit with clean tracked tree, and EVSP_EXPECTED_COMMIT. Delete the other 11 from the code path.
rationale: The two kept guards are one command each and run_exact_pool_mip.py:113-128 already enforces them under Slurm. The other 11 (binary sha256 of python3/scontrol, worker self-hash, per-file hashes over ~22 sources, portable NumPy-SIMD identity equality, held probes, held activation with a 6s observation window, held gate, no-clobber reservations) each convert a heterogeneous-cluster difference into a total stop. Provenance of nothing is worth nothing.
alternatives_rejected: (a) keep all guards -- rejected, zero rows in a week; (b) drop all guards -- rejected, loses the commit binding the MIP already requires

decision: Label ladder-lite outputs execution_mode=ladder_lite_direct_array and keep them in the same normalizer schemas
rationale: Fail open on liveness, fail closed on interpretation. The rows are usable science with an honest provenance label; the approval-hash check on the plan is retained.
alternatives_rejected: Discarding rows for lacking a scheduler receipt

decision: route_weight is reported as 'combined-cost-master route weight', never as a fleet LP lower bound, until the three-phase lexicographic master exists
rationale: The restricted master minimises bus fixed cost plus charging cost; the reported route_weight is a sum of route variables, not the optimised objective. A pricing certificate proves optimality of the combined-cost master in the named route space only.
alternatives_rejected: Presenting route_weight as a minimum-fleet LP bound
